subject: MAP draft: Redwood + FinStream - Next Steps & Pricing Approval
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finstream.com>, Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@finstream.com>
Cc: Angela Morris <angela.morris@finstream.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft: Redwood + FinStream - Next Steps & Pricing Approval

Hi Raj / Samantha —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to get a clearer sense of FinStream's latency targets and compliance constraints for the tokenization pipeline. Attached is the first draft of a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) based on what we discussed. High-level summary below and a few asks to keep momentum: 

MAP highlights (attached: FinStream-MAP-draft.pdf):
- Target close date: 2026-04-15
- Milestone 1 (Week 1-2): Pilot provisioning + SOC 2 evidence handoff — Owner: FinStream (Angela) / Redwood (Marissa)
- Milestone 2 (Week 3-4): Performance tuning + PKI/KMS integration — Owner: Redwood (Eng Lead)
- Milestone 3 (Week 5-8): Production cutover and SLA acceptance tests — Owner: FinStream Prod + Redwood SRE
- Dependencies: SOC 2 artifact access, procurement PO, agreed commit level for discounted pricing

Pricing / commercial ask:
- Requested discount: 20% for a 12-month committed spend (customer proposed)
- Requested onboarding credits: $25k for implementation and runbook work

Could you (1) confirm acceptance of the milestones/owners above, and (2) confirm whether FinStream is comfortable with the target close date and the requested commit level so we can route pricing internally?

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the attached MAP and mark any changes inline (we can iterate)
2) I’ll escalate pricing/credit request to our sales leadership and return with an approval or counter by EOD Tue (Mar 3)
3) If pricing is approved, we’ll circulate a revised MAP + SOW for procurement and legal

Attachments: FinStream-MAP-draft.pdf (1 page), redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx (1 sheet)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: MAP draft: Redwood + FinStream - Next Steps & Pricing Approval

Thanks Marissa — the MAP looks like a good starting point. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Discount / commit: The 20% discount is contingent on a 12-month committed spend of $180k+ (we proposed in our budget), can you confirm Redwood can sign up to that level?
2) Credits: The $25k onboarding credit would cover the initial integration work — we need confirmation that this can be applied up-front or amortized across invoices.
3) SOC 2 artifacts: Angela will share a link to the evidence bucket once we lock the timeline.

Also cc’ing our procurement lead Angela for PO/timing. If this needs leadership approval on pricing, please loop them in. We’re aiming to start the pilot the week of Mar 15 and would like the commercial terms agreed before then.

Raj

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-03-02T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft: Redwood + FinStream - Pricing approval request (RDW-2026-0923)

Team — forwarding FinStream's note. They are asking for a 20% discount on a 12-month $180k commit and $25k onboarding credit, start pilot wk of Mar 15. We need a rapid pricing/credit decision to keep the timeline.

Key asks for leadership:
- Approve / decline 20% discount at 12mo / $180k commit (or propose counter)
- Approve $25k onboarding credit (applied up-front or as invoice credit)
- Confirm any required commercial guardrails (legal SOW terms, PO process)

MAP + pricing attached (redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx). If we can get a directional answer today or tomorrow, I’ll share a revised MAP back to FinStream.

Thanks — Marissa

Attachments: redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft: Redwood + FinStream - Pricing approval request (RDW-2026-0923)

Marissa — thanks for the context and attachments. I’ve reviewed the ask. Proposed internal decision:

- Discount: we can approve up to 15% on a 12-month committed spend, conditional on a minimum committed ARR of $150k (i.e., $12.5k/mo).
- Onboarding credit: approve $20k (reduced from $25k) that can be applied against the first two invoices or issued as an invoice credit at contract signature.
- Exec sign-off: final approval requires CRO validation due to deal size; I will route to Aditya for quick sign-off (cc’d).
- Timeline condition: FinStream must confirm the PO and commit by 2026-03-18 for us to hold pricing and onboarding window to meet Mar 15 pilot.

I’m attaching an internal approval note that summarizes these conditions. If Aditya confirms, Marissa, please update the MAP with: 15% discount, $20k onboarding credit, and the PO-by-2026-03-18 clause. Then send to FinStream for acceptance.

Attachments: internal-pricing-approval-note.pdf

Lauren Bishop
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finstream.com>, Angela Morris <angela.morris@finstream.com>
Cc: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@finstream.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Revised MAP + pricing update (action required by 2026-03-18)

Raj / Angela — following internal review, please find a revised MAP attached (FinStream-MAP-revised.pdf) that incorporates the counter from Redwood leadership:

Commercial summary (Redwood counter):
- 15% discount for a 12-month committed spend (minimum $150k total commit)
- $20k onboarding credit, applied as invoice credit across the first two invoices
- Condition: FinStream to provide signed PO/contract by 2026-03-18 to preserve pricing and the Mar 15 pilot window

Updated milestones and responsibilities are shown in the attached MAP draft. Next steps if you accept the counter:
1) Angela / Procurement to confirm PO timing and whether they prefer a one-time invoice or net-30 payment terms
2) We’ll finalize SOW and legal redlines after PO receipt (we can also start SOC 2 evidence transfer in parallel)
3) Marissa to schedule a 30-min alignment call next week to confirm cutover plan

Please reply with acceptance or let me know any redlines by EOD Thu (Mar 11) so we can keep to the Mar 15 pilot schedule.

Attachments: FinStream-MAP-revised.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
